item.title: [394] Stellar Blade 2 speculation thread
item.description:
We already have a bunch of 'everyone's seething about ''''child'''' protag' and 'east vs west devs' threads but barely anyone talks about the trailer contents other than Evie's ass.
So what's your take on the timeline?
Any details you notice that seem important?

>SB2 happens several decades, maybe centuries after SB1
>protag is Eve's 'descendant'
>Earth real human population somehow recovers and rebuilds
>results of naytiba research used for bio terrorism (got some doom cult vibes from the first screaming guy who transformed)
While we got large amount of close quarters combat shots and some acrobatics the other details were sparse.
Operator girl called Evie 'Angel' but it's hard to tell whether it's just her callsign or if she's from the orbital colony.
Shift Up will likely drip feed small details to keep the hype going so I hope we'll 'connect' to main story from SB1 somewhere along the way.

item.title: [ 48] Am I fucked if I'm put on a PIP?
item.description:
Been at a fortune 500 company for 4 years. No problems until today. I'm a dev btw. Get random email from my manager today about a performance meeting. No mention of my performance prior to this aside from a comment about me not always being in the office as much and working from home.

Thing is I've been crushing it at work and been getting nothing but praise from clients and managers. Just last week the manager from the PIP meeting was telling me I'm being moved to another team because I completed so much work on the current one and they need my assistance with another dev team. Now he's saying bs out his ass about performance. And unironically while I'm on the call with him and hr today about this PIP bullshit another manager pinged me to tell me several clients were telling him how much they love working with me

It feels like the goals in the PIP are set up to make me fail. They basically want me working across 3 teams all at once now along with some online classes because I "lack skills" even though I've taken their skill assessment tests and scored proficient on them. I honestly hate the place so I'm not worried and I've got some investments I can liquidate to help me out with bills until I figure something out or get another job. I'm just so confused like what in the fuck caused this? Not only have I done what's been asked of me but I complete more work than others and that's easy to prove. They've got the metrics so what the fuck. Now I gotta look for another tech job in this bs industry.

item.title: [ 82] /out/ings with a pipe
item.description:
Last thread >>2856593

This is a thread for enjoying a pipe while doing outdoor activities. If you ask why this belongs on /out/, you've never spent
an evening by the campfire with a pipe silently enjoying the nature around you, and you're missing out.

>how to get started
Purchase a corn cob pipe (or a cheap briar pipe) and a pouch of Half and Half or Captain Black tobacco from a smoke shop
or online. You will need a lighter or match, and something to tamp it with--a large nail works well if you don't have a pipe tool.
Fill the pipe with tobacco, pack it down halfway, top it off, pack it down to 3/4, top it off again, pack gently and enjoy. Smoke
slower than you think you need to, the tobacco tastes best when it is burning cool. Tamp and re-light as needed. If you still
have trouble, try different methods on YouTube until you find one that works for you.
>smoking a pipe will give you cancer
Originally the Surgeon General found that pipe and cigar smokers, following a careful study of the statistics (at a time when
most adults smoked, so they had a good sample size), had insignificant death rate increases. Nowadays, tobacco is being
legislated against while hard drugs are being legalized. Put two and two together. Tobacco is just another good thing under attack by the government.

>muh weed
Not the time or place. Start your own thread.

All tobacco users welcome.
